hook: Guillaume Lample spent his early career at Facebook AI Research pushing multilingual natural language processing forward, then helped build the LLaMA models that reshaped the open-weight AI race. In April 2023 he left Meta to co-found Mistral AI with Arthur Mensch and Timothee Lacroix, taking the role of Chief Scientist. Within two months the young company had raised a European-record seed round, and within six months it had shipped an open-weight model that rivals judged competitive with far larger closed systems. He remains the technical architect behind Mistral's model line, from the first 7B release through its largest frontier models.
name: Guillaume Lample

quote.text: Today, we release Mistral Large 2, the new version of our largest model. Mistral Large 2 is a 123B-parameter model with a 128k context window. On many benchmarks, notably in code generation and math, it is superior or on par with Llama 3.1 405B.

standing.standing: Guillaume Lample stands in the records as co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI, a research lab in Paris founded in 2023. He co-founded the company in April 2023 with Arthur Mensch and Timothee Lacroix. The profile describes him as the technical architect behind Mistral's model line, from the first 7B release through its largest frontier models. Before Mistral, he was a research scientist at Facebook AI Research, where he worked on the LLaMA family of open language models. He is also first-listed co-author of Cross-lingual Language Model Pretraining, known as XLM, and co-author of Word Translation Without Parallel Data. The records also note that he led Mistral AI through a European-record 105 million euro seed round in June 2023.

quick_facts: Co-founded Mistral AI in April 2023 with Arthur Mensch and Timothee Lacroix, and serves as its Chief Scientist
Previously a research scientist at Facebook AI Research, where he worked on the LLaMA family of open language models
First-listed co-author of "Cross-lingual Language Model Pretraining" (XLM), a widely cited multilingual NLP paper from FAIR
Co-author of "Word Translation Without Parallel Data," a 2017 paper on learning bilingual dictionaries without parallel text
Studied at Ecole Polytechnique and holds a master's degree in artificial intelligence from Carnegie Mellon University
